verdict.rationale: Bulk data import is a fair question for an identity and fraud decisioning platform that ingests customers and transactions. However, the evidence covers only real-time Events API submissions, webhook delivery retries and 206 partial-data evaluations, none of which is a bulk import job with progress tracking or resume. Webhook retry logic and evaluation warnings are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bulk customer and transaction imports and resume after partial failure
